text:
hana: Heads-up: running a focused entitlement sweep for analytics svc accounts next Tue. Owners will get a ping to keep/demote.

diego: quick note: saw a burst of KMS grants for svc-ml-trainer during the 03/22 deploy window. recommend we exempt any grants created during deploys with `deploy_tag` for this pass.

lee: agree. we had a deploy that caused webhook 502s and a few missing audit events. i'll try to backfill from s3 raw payloads; if missing we'll mark `audit_gap` and exempt for 30 days.

sam: can we make the prune job skip grants with `created_at >= now() - INTERVAL '14 days' OR metadata ? 'deploy_tag'`? safer than ad-hoc fixes.

access-bot: Automation: scheduled prune "analytics-svc-prune" 2026-04-11T03:00Z. Current grace_days=7. To modify grace_days, open PR infra/tools/admin-prune#update-grace.

diego: i'll assemble a whitelist of deploy-tagged grants and share by Mon EOD. also attaching a quick query to find suspect grants:
```
SELECT grant_id, principal, created_at, metadata->>'deploy_tag' AS deploy_tag
FROM kms_grants
WHERE principal LIKE 'svc-ml-%'
  AND created_at >= '2026-03-20'
ORDER BY created_at DESC;
```

hana: good. lee, if backfill finds missing requestor we'll set `do_not_prune=true`. if not found, tag `audit_gap` and exclude. please open infra ticket for schema fields so this is persistent.

lee: creating infra#3120 to add `audit_gap`, `deploy_tag`, `do_not_prune`. will also make the webhook idempotent so retries don't create duplicates.

infra-bot: Action queued: create PR infra#3120. To pause prune for affected principals add label `hold-analytics-prune`.

sam: i'll hold changing grace_days for now. once the whitelist is in we can decide on 14 vs 21 days.

hana: plan recap: (1) diego -> whitelist by Mon, (2) lee -> infra#3120 + backfill s3, (3) sam -> decide final grace_days and run, (4) access-bot -> pause if label applied. resume after verification.

access-bot: Acknowledged. To pause automation comment `hold-analytics-prune` in the PR thread.

diego: thanks. will post the whitelist and a short CSV with `grant_id,principal,created_at,deploy_tag` before EOD Monday.
